integrity: Embedded complete proof and standalone Python checker; exhaustive labelled-graph and pair-distance tests for all r=2..8 and k=1..r; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: All-parameter proof is confined to clique coronas K_r with one private leaf at every clique vertex, with r>=2, independent-set cardinality 1<=k<=r, and distance-at-most-two token moves. No claim for arbitrary split graphs, one-hop moves, or other graphs. Priority against unindexed equivalents remains subject to external review.
title: Exact two-hop token reconfiguration metrics on thin spiders
